explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated directly into a shell command string executed via os.system(). Crafted input containing shell metacharacters could execute arbitrary OS commands on the host. The repair remains vulnerable: although it switches to subprocess.run() with shell=False, it still interpolates user_input via an f-string inside ['bash', '-c', ...], allowing the shell to interpret injected commands.
